synopsis: The booklet identifies EN 50716:2023 as the current railway software development standard and the successor to EN 50128 [f7717, f7718, f15360]. The glossary places EN 50716 among European-only standards, alongside railway standard EN 14363 and earth-moving machinery standard EN 474 [f15021]. Both Chapter 10 and the glossary nevertheless list EN 50716 as not verified in this research [f7716, f15361]. Specifically, its relevance to off-road automatic braking, risk scaling, validation against physical data, validity envelopes and transfer rules, and remaining physical evidence were not verified; its catalogue identification therefore does not establish applicability to the braking system [f8155, f7717, f7718].
